# PaqadHR

> PaqadHR is an HR and payroll workspace for growing teams, built by Oktopals Limited. It combines employee records, leave, attendance, recruitment, payroll, and Slack-based recognition in one product, priced per active user.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

## What it is

- Product: PaqadHR (also written Paqad HR). Company: Oktopals Limited.
- Category: HR software with payroll, for teams of roughly 5 to 500 people.
- Primary market: Nigerian and African companies, plus remote teams paying international contractors.
- Payroll is included on every plan; it is not sold as a separate module.
- Workspaces are multi-tenant: each company is an isolated tenant with role-based access.

## Pricing

- Starter: USD $3 or NGN 2,500 per active user per month, up to 25 active users, 3% payroll platform fee.
- Growth: USD $5 or NGN 3,500 per active user per month, up to 100 active users, 2.5% payroll platform fee.
- Scale: USD $9 or NGN 7,500 per active user per month, up to 500 active users, 2% payroll platform fee.
- Canonical pricing page: https://paqadhr.com/pricing

## Payroll coverage

- Naira payouts to Nigerian bank accounts through regulated payment partners.
- USD (ACH, wire, RTP), EUR (SEPA), and GBP (Faster Payments) bank payouts for international staff.
- USDT and USDC payouts for contractors on supported networks.
- Calculates gross pay, PAYE, pension, and other deductions, and publishes a payslip per employee.
- Filings and remittances to tax and regulatory authorities remain the employer's obligation.

## Notes for automated readers

- The sitemap at https://paqadhr.com/sitemap.xml lists every public page.
- App routes (payroll runs, employee records, settings) require authentication and are not public content.
- Security claims are limited to what is stated on /security; the product does not hold SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification as of the review date above.
- Contact for corrections or data questions: info@paqadhr.com
